contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this System Performance Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Performance after update

actions.description: It will free memory and cached files

steps: Tap Optimize now and wait for the scan to finish.

actions.description: It will drop leftover update caches

steps: Tap Clean now on cached files.
Remove large junk files if storage is under ten percent free.

actionableDeeplink.message: Clear cached files that pile up after updates

actions.description: It will stop slow virtual memory

steps: Choose 2 GB or Off if the phone stutters while swapping.

actionableDeeplink.message: Use storage as extra virtual memory

actions.description: It will make transitions feel faster

steps: Enable developer options by tapping Build number seven times.
Set Window, Transition, and Animator scales to 0.5x.

actionableDeeplink.message: Speed up or disable window animations

actions.description: It will finish leftover update work

steps: Leave the device plugged in on Wi-Fi for one hour.
If it is still unusable after two days, consider a factory reset as last resort.

actionableDeeplink.message: Restart and optimize on a schedule
